disagreements.boundary: ASGE suggests drainage within 48 hours generally; ESGE stratifies timing by severity. No universal exact hour cutoff or mild/moderate deadline scored. Deterioration-based urgency is retained.
2025 guidance conditionally favors routine IOC; 2020 elective benefit was inconclusive. No question treats routine IOC as mandatory for every uncomplicated operation.
Different short- and long-term outcomes and confounding prevent one universal subtotal-type superiority rule. Only observed inability to close tissue is used in exact historical PASS metadata.
